what: Every time the cursor moves 40px inside the area (at window width 1600, range 28~64px), a photo pops in at the cursor position, growing from 0 with .55s back.out(1.25), rests .05s, then spins one full turn (360°) while shrinking to 0 and vanishing over .8s power4.inOut. The faster you move, the bigger the photo (190 + 120 × speed px, 150~420) and the larger the initial tilt (±15° × (1 + 2 × speed)) — speed is px/ms ÷ 1.2, smoothed by mixing .75 and .25. Photos stack on top in the order placed and are reused in rotation (max 18).

options.step: Cursor distance between photos (px, proportional to window width), default 40
options.size: Photo width when slow (px), default 190 · extra width added when fast with grow, default 120
options.max: Number of photos to cycle, default 18
options.base: Reads values at this width and scales with window width (.64~1.6x), default 1600 — at 0 values stay as px
options.data-fx-part=\"source\": Photos to float (hidden) — used in turn
options.data-fx-part=\"layer\": Panel to float the photo on (the element itself if none)

note: Not applied on hover-less (touch) devices or with reduced-motion settings

from.where: index.html closing footer — 11 speaker photos bounce after the cursor, spin and fade out (original el: 40·190·120·.95·.55 back.out(1.25)·.05·.8 power4.inOut·18 photos)
